description: Find cannabis-based medicines on the UK market by product, brand or strain name, or by dose form. Returns up to 25 products with page URL, slug, brand, dose form, THC and CBD content, and the latest price a UK pharmacy charged (naming no pharmacy) when Findabis publishes one. It does not return stock, pack sizes on offer, per-pharmacy prices or which pharmacies dispense a product: those are shown only to patients and professionals with access. A listing is not a statement that a product suits anyone. For one product in full, use get_product with its slug.

category.description: Dose form. CARTRIDGE is a vape cartridge.

query.description: Product, brand or strain name, e.g. "Pink Kush" or "Tilray". Omit to browse.

thc.description: THC content as the page prints it, unit included

url.description: Canonical Findabis page, absolute; null when the listing has no page

total.description: How many matched in all; narrow the query when this exceeds the results
